issues.description: The lithium-ion pack and protection board are listed, but cell retention, charging safeguards, thermal separation, and protection verification are not specified.
issues.fix: Specify a restrained pack, matched charger and protection design, thermal clearances, and applicable battery safety test evidence before production.
issues.rule_citation: Safety requirements and tests for portable lithium cells and batteries — IEC 62133-2

issues.description: The boss design and screw locations are unspecified, so the self-tapping screws cannot be checked for engagement, access, cracking, or sink on the painted exterior.
issues.fix: Add boss and rib sections, screw locations, driver-access envelopes, and supplier-validated pilot and engagement dimensions.
issues.rule_citation: Boss and rib walls should be about 60% or less of nominal wall to limit sink — Protolabs injection molding design guide

issues.description: The shell mating-face and split-line requirements lack datums, inspection locations, and an assembly stack-up; the paint build-up is also unaccounted for.
issues.fix: Define functional datums and inspection points, dimension the assembled gap and step, and allow for coating thickness in the stack-up.
issues.rule_citation: Dimensions and tolerances require defined references for inspection — ISO 1101 geometric tolerancing principles

issues.description: The battery pack, motors, sensors, arm, and charging interface have no specified mounts or cable routing, leaving retention, service access, and wire-pinching risks unresolved.
issues.fix: Provide an assembly layout with mounting features, connector access, cable restraints, and clearance checks through moving joints and shell closure.
issues.rule_citation: Provide assembly access and avoid trapped wiring — Boothroyd, Dewhurst and Knight, Product Design for Manufacture and Assembly

issues.description: Projected area along +Z: 72961 mm² (part silhouette, per cavity). Estimated clamp force ≈ 373.2 t (Estimate: area in² × 3.0 t/in² for PC/ABS × 1.1 safety) — per cavity; a family tool moulding both shells in one shot roughly doubles it.
issues.fix: Quote on a press ≥ 450 t; keep both shells in one family mould only if tonnage allows.
issues.rule_citation: Clamp force ≈ projected area × cavity-pressure factor (2-5 t/in²) — Protolabs injection molding design guidelines; silhouette raster from text-to-cad DFM skill (mold_tool.py, MIT) ported to OCCT

measurement.label: measured
measurement.source_or_assumption: Silhouette along +Z, raster 0.75 mm — text-to-cad DFM skill (mold_tool.py, MIT) ported to OCCT

issues.description: Measured wall 2.20-2.20 mm is within the PC/ABS 1.2-3.5 mm range; keep bosses/ribs ≤ 60% of nominal wall to avoid sink.
issues.fix: No change to nominal wall; core bosses and ribs to ≤ 60% of the wall.
issues.rule_citation: PC/ABS wall 1.2-3.5 mm, ribs/bosses ≤ 60% of wall — Protolabs injection molding design guidelines

measurement.source_or_assumption: 5th percentile of 11402 ray samples into the material (median 2.2 mm)

issues.description: The soft-touch coating has no adhesion, wear, or cleaning-agent requirements despite handling and cleaning in home use.
issues.fix: Specify coating thickness and acceptance tests for adhesion, abrasion, and intended household cleaners on the selected PC/ABS.
issues.rule_citation: Cross-cut adhesion testing for coatings — ISO 2409
